About the firm

An approach built around outcomes, not billable hours.

We're a Tashkent-based firm that treats every matter as if it were our own — and builds the tools to prove it, not just the paperwork.

Individual approach

We study each matter closely and shape a strategy around your specific goals, not a standard template.

Deep practice experience

Our advocates bring years of courtroom, transactional, and regulatory experience across sectors.

Confidentiality by default

Every matter is handled under strict confidentiality and professional ethics, without exception.

Full-spectrum coverage

From a single contract review to complex cross-border disputes, one firm handles it end to end.

Legal technology, in-house

We build our own tools, like Huquqda, to make routine legal work faster and more affordable.

Practice areas

Where we practice

Comprehensive coverage across the matters that affect businesses and individuals most, handled by advocates who specialize in each.

Corporate & business law

Formation, governance, transactions, and day-to-day counsel for growing companies.

Contract law

Drafting, review, and negotiation that closes gaps before they become disputes.

Civil & commercial litigation

Representation in court from initial filing through appeal.

Criminal defense

Defense counsel and case strategy at every stage of criminal proceedings.

Labor law

Employment contracts, workplace disputes, and compliance with labor legislation.

Family law

Divorce, custody, division of property, and related proceedings, handled with discretion.

Intellectual property & technology

Patents, trademarks, copyright, and legal support for technology products.

Real estate & construction

Transactions, permitting, and dispute resolution across development projects.

Legal technology

Projects built by our own team

Featured project

Huquqda — legal help, without the waiting room.

Huquqda is our in-house legal-technology platform. It lets people prepare court-ready filings, book a video consultation, or secure full legal representation — directly through a Telegram bot, in minutes rather than weeks.

  • Instant draft filings for alimony, divorce, and residence disputes
  • Video consultations booked around your schedule
  • Secure payment through Click and Payme
  • Licensed advocates behind every case
